_comment: Control 6. Targets the WAF policy resource itself. Alias: Microsoft.Network/ApplicationGatewayWebApplicationFirewallPolicies/managedRules.managedRuleSets[*].ruleSetVersion - VERIFY, this alias is long and version-sensitive. Count expression checks that EVERY managed rule set is on an approved version.
displayName: WAF policy must use an approved managed rule set version
description: Baseline is Microsoft_DefaultRuleSet 2.2. DRS 2.1 is permitted only where the platform does not support 2.2 (Application Gateway for Containers).

metadata.description: DRS versions plus Bot Manager 1.1. Narrow this list as the estate converges.
